name: Flutter & Android Dev
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'mkdir -p /tmp/flutter && wget -qO- https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_3.19.6-stable.tar.xz | tar -xJ -C /tmp && mkdir -p /tmp/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest && wget -q https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip -O /tmp/cmdline-tools.zip && unzip -q /tmp/cmdline-tools.zip -d /tmp/cmdline-tools-temp && mv /tmp/cmdline-tools-temp/cmdline-tools/* /tmp/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/ && rm -rf /tmp/cmdline-tools-temp /tmp/cmdline-tools.zip && yes | /tmp/android-sdk/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager --sdk_root=/tmp/android-sdk "platform-tools" "platforms;android-33" "build-tools;33.0.2"'
